```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)

# Load data
visuals_data <- read_csv("Visuals_data_cleaned.csv",
                         col_types = cols(
                           State = col_character(),
                           Year = col_factor(levels = c("1860", "1870"), ordered = TRUE),
                           `Mentally Ill` = col_double(),
                           Blind = col_double(),
                           `Developmentally Disabled` = col_double(),
                           `Deaf-Mutes` = col_double()
                         ))

# Convert to long format
visuals_long <- visuals_data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(`Mentally Ill`, Blind, `Developmentally Disabled`, `Deaf-Mutes`),
               names_to = "Category",
               values_to = "Count")

# Define the 10 specific states and their ratio calculations
target_ratios <- list(
  "MINNESOTA" = list(category = "Developmentally Disabled", ratio_type = "1860_to_1870"),
  "LOUISIANA" = list(category = "Mentally Ill", ratio_type = "1860_to_1870"),
  "WISCONSIN" = list(category = "Developmentally Disabled", ratio_type = "1860_to_1870"),
  "IOWA" = list(category = "Developmentally Disabled", ratio_type = "1860_to_1870"),
  "SOUTH CAROLINA" = list(category = "Mentally Ill", ratio_type = "1860_to_1870"),
  "TENNESSEE" = list(category = "Mentally Ill", ratio_type = "1860_to_1870"),
  "GEORGIA" = list(category = "Mentally Ill", ratio_type = "1860_to_1870"),
  "KENTUCKY" = list(category = "Developmentally Disabled", ratio_type = "1860_to_1870"),
  "MAINE" = list(category = "Developmentally Disabled", ratio_type = "1860_to_1870"),
  "MISSOURI" = list(category = "Mentally Ill", ratio_type = "1860_to_1870")
)

# Calculate individual state ratios (smaller/bigger for each state)
calculate_ratios <- function(data, target_states) {
  ratios_df <- data.frame(
    State = character(),
    Category = character(),
    Ratio_1860_to_1870 = numeric(),
    Count_1860 = numeric(),
    Count_1870 = numeric(),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  for (state in names(target_states)) {
    category <- target_states[[state]]$category

    state_data <- data %>%
      filter(State == state, Category == category) %>%
      select(State, Year, Category, Count) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = Year, values_from = Count)

    if (nrow(state_data) > 0) {
      count_1860 <- state_data$`1860`
      count_1870 <- state_data$`1870`
      
      # Calculate ratio as smaller/bigger to ensure it's always < 1
      if (count_1860 <= count_1870) {
        ratio <- count_1860 / count_1870
      } else {
        ratio <- count_1870 / count_1860
      }

      ratios_df <- rbind(ratios_df, data.frame(
        State = state,
        Category = category,
        Ratio_1860_to_1870 = ratio,
        Count_1860 = count_1860,
        Count_1870 = count_1870,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      ))
    }
  }

  return(ratios_df)
}

# Calculate ratios for our target states
state_ratios <- calculate_ratios(visuals_long, target_ratios)
print("Calculated Ratios (all should be <= 1):")
print(state_ratios)

# FIXED: Define the 5 specific pairs as requested using c() instead of list()
specific_pairs <- list(
  c("TENNESSEE", "MAINE"),
  c("SOUTH CAROLINA", "GEORGIA"),
  c("WISCONSIN", "IOWA"),
  c("KENTUCKY", "MISSOURI"),
  c("MINNESOTA", "LOUISIANA")
)

cat("\nTotal number of specific pairs:", length(specific_pairs), "\n")

# Enhanced plotting function with anonymous labeling
create_anonymous_pair_plot <- function(data, vis_type, states, pair_number, ratios_data) {
  # Get the categories for each state
  state1_category <- target_ratios[[states[1]]]$category
  state2_category <- target_ratios[[states[2]]]$category

  # Filter data for both states and their respective categories
  df1 <- data %>% 
    filter(Category == state1_category, State == states[1])

  df2 <- data %>% 
    filter(Category == state2_category, State == states[2])

  # Create anonymous labels: State A and State B (no category info)
  df1$Anonymous_State <- "State A"
  df2$Anonymous_State <- "State B"
  
  # Combine the data
  df <- rbind(df1, df2) %>%
    mutate(Anonymous_State = factor(Anonymous_State, levels = c("State A", "State B")))

  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    stop(paste("No data found for pair:", paste(states, collapse = " vs ")))
  }

  if (vis_type == "polar") {
    p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = 1, y = Count, fill = Year)) +
      geom_col(position = "identity", alpha = 0.5) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("1860" = "orange", "1870" = "blue")) +
      coord_polar(theta = "x") +
      facet_wrap(~ Anonymous_State, ncol = 2) +
      theme_void() +
      theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"))

  } else {
    base_plot <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Anonymous_State, y = Count, fill = Year)) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("1860" = "orange", "1870" = "blue")) +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")) +
      labs(x = "", y = "Count")

    if (vis_type == "overlaid") {
      p <- base_plot +
        # to change how overlapped they are change the position_dodge(width = x), as x approaches 0, it gets more overlaid 
         geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = .04), width = 0.7, alpha = 0.5, color = "black")

    } else if (vis_type == "dodged") {
      p <- base_plot +
        geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = .8), width = 0.7, alpha = 0.5, color = "black")
    } else {
      stop("Unknown visual type")
    }
  }

  return(p)
}

# Create output folder
if (!dir.exists("specific_pairs_anonymous")) {
  dir.create("specific_pairs_anonymous")
}

# Define visualization types
visual_types <- c("polar", "overlaid", "dodged")

# Generate plots for the 5 specific pairs only
cat("\nGenerating plots for", length(specific_pairs), "specific pairs...\n")

for (i in seq_along(specific_pairs)) {
  pair <- specific_pairs[[i]]
  cat("Processing pair", i, ":", paste(pair, collapse = " vs "), "\n")

  for (vis in visual_types) {
    tryCatch({
      # Create safe filename with pair number only (no state names)
      file_name <- paste0("specific_pairs_anonymous/Pair_", i, "_", vis, ".png")

      plot_obj <- create_anonymous_pair_plot(visuals_long, vis, pair, i, state_ratios)
      ggsave(file_name, plot = plot_obj, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)

    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("Error creating", vis, "plot for pair", i, ":", e$message, "\n")
    })
  }
}

# Create a mapping file (for your reference only - don't share with viewers)
pair_mapping <- data.frame(
  Pair_Number = 1:length(specific_pairs),
  State_A = sapply(specific_pairs, `[`, 1),
  State_B = sapply(specific_pairs, `[`, 2),
  State_A_Category = sapply(specific_pairs, function(x) target_ratios[[x[1]]]$category),
  State_B_Category = sapply(specific_pairs, function(x) target_ratios[[x[2]]]$category)
)

write.csv(pair_mapping, "specific_pairs_anonymous/pair_mapping_CONFIDENTIAL.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Create summary with anonymous data (safe to share)
anonymous_summary <- data.frame(
  Pair_Number = 1:length(specific_pairs),
  State_A_Category = sapply(specific_pairs, function(x) target_ratios[[x[1]]]$category),
  State_B_Category = sapply(specific_pairs, function(x) target_ratios[[x[2]]]$category)
)

write.csv(anonymous_summary, "specific_pairs_anonymous/anonymous_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)

cat("\nPlot generation complete!\n")
cat("- Check 'specific_pairs_anonymous' folder for", length(specific_pairs) * length(visual_types), "plots\n")
cat("- Confidential mapping (for your eyes only): pair_mapping_CONFIDENTIAL.csv\n")
cat("- Anonymous summary (safe to share): anonymous_summary.csv\n")

print("\nPair mapping (CONFIDENTIAL - for your reference only):")
print(pair_mapping)

print("\nAnonymous summary (safe to share with viewers):")
print(anonymous_summary)


```



```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)

# Load data
visuals_data <- read_csv("Visuals_data_cleaned.csv",
                         col_types = cols(
                           State = col_character(),
                           Year = col_factor(levels = c("1860", "1870"), ordered = TRUE),
                           `Mentally Ill` = col_double(),
                           Blind = col_double(),
                           `Developmentally Disabled` = col_double(),
                           `Deaf-Mutes` = col_double()
                         ))

# Convert to long format
visuals_long <- visuals_data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(`Mentally Ill`, Blind, `Developmentally Disabled`, `Deaf-Mutes`),
               names_to = "Category",
               values_to = "Count")

# Define the 10 specific states and their ratio calculations
target_ratios <- list(
  "MINNESOTA" = list(category = "Developmentally Disabled", ratio_type = "1860_to_1870"),
  "LOUISIANA" = list(category = "Mentally Ill", ratio_type = "1860_to_1870"),
  "WISCONSIN" = list(category = "Developmentally Disabled", ratio_type = "1860_to_1870"),
  "IOWA" = list(category = "Developmentally Disabled", ratio_type = "1860_to_1870"),
  "SOUTH CAROLINA" = list(category = "Mentally Ill", ratio_type = "1860_to_1870"),
  "TENNESSEE" = list(category = "Mentally Ill", ratio_type = "1860_to_1870"),
  "GEORGIA" = list(category = "Mentally Ill", ratio_type = "1860_to_1870"),
  "KENTUCKY" = list(category = "Developmentally Disabled", ratio_type = "1860_to_1870"),
  "MAINE" = list(category = "Developmentally Disabled", ratio_type = "1860_to_1870"),
  "MISSOURI" = list(category = "Mentally Ill", ratio_type = "1860_to_1870")
)

# Calculate individual state ratios (smaller/bigger for each state)
calculate_ratios <- function(data, target_states) {
  ratios_df <- data.frame(
    State = character(),
    Category = character(),
    Ratio_1860_to_1870 = numeric(),
    Count_1860 = numeric(),
    Count_1870 = numeric(),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  for (state in names(target_states)) {
    category <- target_states[[state]]$category

    state_data <- data %>%
      filter(State == state, Category == category) %>%
      select(State, Year, Category, Count) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = Year, values_from = Count)

    if (nrow(state_data) > 0) {
      count_1860 <- state_data$`1860`
      count_1870 <- state_data$`1870`
      
      # Calculate ratio as smaller/bigger to ensure it's always < 1
      if (count_1860 <= count_1870) {
        ratio <- count_1860 / count_1870
      } else {
        ratio <- count_1870 / count_1860
      }

      ratios_df <- rbind(ratios_df, data.frame(
        State = state,
        Category = category,
        Ratio_1860_to_1870 = ratio,
        Count_1860 = count_1860,
        Count_1870 = count_1870,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      ))
    }
  }

  return(ratios_df)
}

# Calculate ratios for our target states
state_ratios <- calculate_ratios(visuals_long, target_ratios)
print("Calculated Ratios (all should be <= 1):")
print(state_ratios)

# Generate ALL possible pairs from the 8 states
target_state_names <- names(target_ratios)
all_possible_pairs <- combn(target_state_names, 2, simplify = FALSE)

cat("\nTotal number of possible pairs:", length(all_possible_pairs), "\n")

# Enhanced plotting function that can handle mixed categories
create_enhanced_pair_plot <- function(data, vis_type, states, ratios_data) {
  # Get the categories for each state
  state1_category <- target_ratios[[states[1]]]$category
  state2_category <- target_ratios[[states[2]]]$category

  # Filter data for both states and their respective categories
  df1 <- data %>% 
    filter(Category == state1_category, State == states[1])

  df2 <- data %>% 
    filter(Category == state2_category, State == states[2])

  # Combine the data
  df <- rbind(df1, df2) %>%
    mutate(State = factor(State, levels = states))  # Preserve order

  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    stop(paste("No data found for:", paste(states, collapse = " vs ")))
  }

  # Create title WITHOUT ratio information (as requested)
  title_text <- paste0(vis_type, " - ", states[1], " (", state1_category, 
                       ") vs ", states[2], " (", state2_category, ")")

  if (vis_type == "polar") {
    p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = 1, y = Count, fill = Year)) +
      geom_col(position = "identity", alpha = 0.5) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("1860" = "grey90", "1870" = "black")) +
      coord_polar(theta = "x") +
      facet_wrap(~ paste(State, Category, sep = "\n"), ncol = 2) +
      theme_void() +
      labs(title = title_text)

  } else {
    # Create combined state-category labels for x-axis
    df$State_Category <- paste(df$State, df$Category, sep = "\n")

    base_plot <- ggplot(df, aes(x = State_Category, y = Count, fill = Year)) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("1860" = "grey90", "1870" = "black")) +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8)) +
      labs(title = title_text,
           x = "State / Category",
           y = "Count")

    if (vis_type == "overlaid") {
      p <- base_plot +
        geom_col(position = "identity", alpha = 0.5, color = "black")

    } else if (vis_type == "dodged") {
      p <- base_plot +
        geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = .8), width = 0.7, alpha = 0.5, color = "black")
    } else {
      stop("Unknown visual type")
    }
  }

  return(p)
}

# Create output folder
if (!dir.exists("all_pairs_ratios")) {
  dir.create("all_pairs_ratios")
}

# Define visualization types
visual_types <- c("polar", "overlaid", "dodged")

# Generate all plots for every possible pair
cat("\nGenerating plots for all", length(all_possible_pairs), "possible pairs...\n")

for (i in seq_along(all_possible_pairs)) {
  pair <- all_possible_pairs[[i]]
  cat("Processing pair", i, ":", paste(pair, collapse = " vs "), "\n")

  for (vis in visual_types) {
    tryCatch({
      # Create safe filename
      file_name <- paste0("all_pairs_ratios/Pair_", i, "_", 
                         paste(pair, collapse = "_"), "_", 
                         vis, ".png")

      plot_obj <- create_enhanced_pair_plot(visuals_long, vis, pair, state_ratios)
      ggsave(file_name, plot = plot_obj, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)

    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("Error creating", vis, "plot for", paste(pair, collapse = " vs "), ":", e$message, "\n")
    })
  }
}

# Create a summary table of all ratios
write.csv(state_ratios, "all_pairs_ratios/state_ratios_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# FULLY CORRECTED: Create pairs_summary with all calculations based on raw 1870 counts
pairs_summary <- data.frame(
  Pair_Number = 1:length(all_possible_pairs),
  State1 = sapply(all_possible_pairs, `[`, 1),
  State2 = sapply(all_possible_pairs, `[`, 2),
  State1_Category = sapply(all_possible_pairs, function(x) target_ratios[[x[1]]]$category),
  State2_Category = sapply(all_possible_pairs, function(x) target_ratios[[x[2]]]$category),
  State1_Ratio = sapply(all_possible_pairs, function(x) {
    state_ratios[state_ratios$State == x[1], "Ratio_1860_to_1870"]
  }),
  State2_Ratio = sapply(all_possible_pairs, function(x) {
    state_ratios[state_ratios$State == x[2], "Ratio_1860_to_1870"]
  })
)

# Add the 1870 count values for each state in each pair
pairs_summary$State1_Count_1870 <- sapply(all_possible_pairs, function(x) {
  state_ratios[state_ratios$State == x[1], "Count_1870"]
})

pairs_summary$State2_Count_1870 <- sapply(all_possible_pairs, function(x) {
  state_ratios[state_ratios$State == x[2], "Count_1870"]
})

# Calculate smaller to bigger ratio using 1870 raw count values
pairs_summary$Smaller_to_Bigger_Ratio <- apply(pairs_summary, 1, function(row) {
  count1_1870 <- as.numeric(row["State1_Count_1870"])
  count2_1870 <- as.numeric(row["State2_Count_1870"])
  
  # Take smaller 1870 count divided by bigger 1870 count
  smaller_count <- min(count1_1870, count2_1870)
  bigger_count <- max(count1_1870, count2_1870)
  
  # Avoid division by zero
  if (bigger_count == 0) {
    return(0)
  }
  
  result <- smaller_count / bigger_count
  return(result)
})

# CORRECTED: Determine which state has smaller/bigger 1870 count (not ratio)
pairs_summary$Smaller_Ratio_State <- apply(pairs_summary, 1, function(row) {
  count1_1870 <- as.numeric(row["State1_Count_1870"])
  count2_1870 <- as.numeric(row["State2_Count_1870"])
  if (count1_1870 <= count2_1870) {
    return(row["State1"])
  } else {
    return(row["State2"])
  }
})

pairs_summary$Bigger_Ratio_State <- apply(pairs_summary, 1, function(row) {
  count1_1870 <- as.numeric(row["State1_Count_1870"])
  count2_1870 <- as.numeric(row["State2_Count_1870"])
  if (count1_1870 >= count2_1870) {
    return(row["State1"])
  } else {
    return(row["State2"])
  }
})

# Verification
cat("\nVerifying pairs_summary calculations:\n")
cat("State1_Ratio range:", min(pairs_summary$State1_Ratio), "to", max(pairs_summary$State1_Ratio), "\n")
cat("State2_Ratio range:", min(pairs_summary$State2_Ratio), "to", max(pairs_summary$State2_Ratio), "\n")
cat("State1_Count_1870 range:", min(pairs_summary$State1_Count_1870), "to", max(pairs_summary$State1_Count_1870), "\n")
cat("State2_Count_1870 range:", min(pairs_summary$State2_Count_1870), "to", max(pairs_summary$State2_Count_1870), "\n")
cat("Smaller_to_Bigger_Ratio range:", min(pairs_summary$Smaller_to_Bigger_Ratio), "to", max(pairs_summary$Smaller_to_Bigger_Ratio), "\n")

# Check that everything is consistent
cat("\nConsistency check - verifying smaller/bigger assignments match ratio calculations:\n")
for (i in 1:min(5, nrow(pairs_summary))) {  # Check first 5 rows as examples
  row <- pairs_summary[i, ]
  count1 <- row$State1_Count_1870
  count2 <- row$State2_Count_1870
  smaller_state <- row$Smaller_Ratio_State
  bigger_state <- row$Bigger_Ratio_State
  calculated_ratio <- row$Smaller_to_Bigger_Ratio
  expected_ratio <- min(count1, count2) / max(count1, count2)
  
  cat("Pair", i, ":", row$State1, "(", count1, ") vs", row$State2, "(", count2, ")\n")
  cat("  Smaller state:", smaller_state, ", Bigger state:", bigger_state, "\n")
  cat("  Calculated ratio:", round(calculated_ratio, 4), ", Expected:", round(expected_ratio, 4), "\n")
  if (abs(calculated_ratio - expected_ratio) > 0.0001) {
    cat("  WARNING: Mismatch!\n")
  } else {
    cat("  OK: Match!\n")
  }
}

if (max(pairs_summary$Smaller_to_Bigger_Ratio) <= 1) {
  cat("SUCCESS: All Smaller_to_Bigger_Ratio values are <= 1\n")
} else {
  cat("WARNING: Some Smaller_to_Bigger_Ratio values are > 1\n")
}

write.csv(pairs_summary, "all_pairs_ratios/pairs_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)

cat("\nPlot generation complete!\n")
cat("- Check 'all_pairs_ratios' folder for all", length(all_possible_pairs) * length(visual_types), "plots\n")
cat("- Ratios summary: state_ratios_summary.csv\n")
cat("- Pairs summary: pairs_summary.csv (All ratios based on 1870 raw counts)\n")

# Print the pairs summary
print("\nAll possible pairs with corrected calculations (all based on 1870 raw counts):")
print(pairs_summary[, c("Pair_Number", "State1", "State2", "State1_Count_1870", "State2_Count_1870", "Smaller_to_Bigger_Ratio", "Smaller_Ratio_State", "Bigger_Ratio_State")])

pairs_summary <- as.data.frame(pairs_summary)

```
